rule: Stop after one or two rounds. More rounds add sycophancy, not accuracy.
Compare against a plain vote. Most of a debate's gain is the vote, at two to three times the tokens.
source: Debate or Vote (2508.17536); Should we be going MAD (ICML 2024)

rule: Diversify the reasoning method, not the persona. Personas do not raise accuracy.
source: DMAD (ICLR 2025); Personas in system prompts (EMNLP 2024 Findings)

rule: Use 3 or 4 distinct roles when judging; quality drops at 5 and with near-duplicate roles.
Keep dissent moderate. 'Disagree with everything' does worse than none.
Never let the author review its own work in the same context.
source: Self-preference and drift studies (31.7% of own drift missed)

rule: Harvest each member's unique ideas before any merge or vote. Plain councils lose about three quarters of them.
source: Strange Loop Canon, LLM councils show groupthink (16 prompts, blind judges)

rule: Treat LLM idea rankings as a sort, not a verdict. LLM idea judgments are near chance against human reviewers.
source: Si et al. 2409.04109 (53.3% vs 56.1% human agreement)
